source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted helper compares the computed hide Boolean with item.hidden. Its diagnostic inserts NOT when hide is true, so both branches describe the opposite expected visibility. The message should say hidden when hide is true and not hidden when false. This is a later accepted-source diagnostic finding; the original 4701 helper used visibility methods and did not contain this conditional message. No test ran.
title: The accepted authentication-option assertion reverses its hidden-state diagnostic
